name: Modern Aminos
coaAccess: COA batch search (modernaminos.com/coa-search/); reports not listed without a batch number
dispatchInfo: Contact page: orders before the 4 PM CT cut-off typically ship the same business day; FedEx or UPS tracking

subscore_reasons.labVerification: Reports are found only through a batch-number search; product pages show no report, lab name or key.
subscore_reasons.fillAccuracy: No report opened, so no measured mg to compare with the label.
subscore_reasons.panelDepth: No test panel could be read without a batch number.
subscore_reasons.entityTransparency: No company name or address found on the pages we could read (the site is behind a bot check; policy pages returned no text).
subscore_reasons.dispatchReliability: Same-day dispatch before 4 PM CT stated on the contact page; shipping policy text could not be read.
subscore_reasons.valuePerMg: BPC-157 $5.40/mg (10 mg) and TB-500 $5.90/mg (10 mg) are around the market middle; no GLP-1-class single compounds except a CagriSema blend.

weaknesses: No lab report can be opened without a batch number
No company name or address found
Site behind a bot check; policy pages could not be read
verdict: Modern Aminos sells about 190 listings and offers a batch-number COA search, but we could not open any report without a batch number and found no company name or address.
summary: US shop (modernaminos.com) with about 190 listings incl. blends, strips and capsules; batch-number COA search; same-day dispatch before 4 PM CT.
notes: Read via the public WooCommerce Store API and WordPress pages API (GET) because the pages are behind a bot check. Other domains using the name (modernaminosusa.com, modernaminos.eu) not audited.
